title: Herald product configuration
description: assets/herald.json in a product APK. Everything a product needs to differ from another product lives here.

application.description: Application slug, as provisioned by heraldctl create-application.

origin.description: Trusted origin. Notification links resolve against it and nothing else.

start_url.description: Opened when a notification carries no link, or carries one that is not on the origin.

web_subscription_bridge.description: Let the PWA read and replace subscriptions over verified TWA postMessage. Requires use_as_origin in assetlinks.json. Protocol in README.md. Defaults to false.

channels.description: Herald channels this product subscribes to, each becoming an Android notification channel of the same id.
